finalists.label: Cardiac Myxoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and detailed evidence for it, including the description of the mass and its attachment to the interventricular septum.

finalists.label: Cardiac Metastasis
finalists.why: It is proposed by a separate pass and has some evidence for it, although less specific than Cardiac Myxoma.

frontier_selector.why: The detailed description of the mass as a mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass originating from the left ventricular lateral wall, measuring 1.34 × 1.9 cm, and its attachment to the interventricular septum with focal contrast enhancement, decided the final comparison in favor of Cardiac Myxoma.
